description: Baseline: untouched source; CANDIDATE identical to ORIGINAL (playground commit ee6320dfd77, off origin/main f59818497a9).

Exp1: BigInt fast path for pure-integer amounts (parse/accumulate in native BigInt; fractional/odd keep BigNumber; hybrid promote/demote on mixed rows; materialize converts bigint->BigNumber once per entry for the fiat product). -10ms vs baseline. Kept in CAND; superseded next by all-BigInt mantissa+scale design if it wins.
Exp1 re-measure (noise sample): same code as run 1.

Exp2: replace hybrid BigInt fast path with uniform [bigint mantissa, scale] accumulation — parseAmount parses every finite amount shape (integers via regex+BigInt, decimals/exponentials via one regex exec; non-finite resolves to skip, matching zero-skip semantics), accumulation rescales by powers of 10, materialize via mantissaToFixed (plain decimal, no exponent, trailing zeros stripped — identical to BigNumber#toFixed); fiat product converts once per entry to BigNumber. 161->101ms (-37%), parity OK incl. edge battery.

Exp3: per-aggregation chain-enablement cache — mergeBalancesIntoMap resolves isChainEnabledByMap once per distinct chainId per aggregation (Map chainId->bool threaded from aggregateBalances) instead of once per asset row. 101->83ms, parity OK. (Builds on exp2.)

Exp4: fiat contribution without BigNumber on the hot path — parsePriceToDecimal converts the price double (String(price), the same decimal BigNumber multiplies by) to an exact [bigint mantissa, scale]; contribution = Number(mantissaToFixed(amount.m*priceM, amount.s+priceS)); plain-decimal StringToNumber is correctly rounded like BigNumber#toNumber. Non-finite price shapes fall back to BigNumber per entry. 83->67ms, parity OK.
Exp5: replace for-in+hasOwnProperty with Object.keys+indexed loop in mergeBalancesIntoMap. 67->67ms (reps 75,66,67), no measurable gain in Hermes. Reverted; keeping production-faithful loop shape.

Exp6: per-aggregation renderable-asset guard cache (Map assetId->meta|null collapsing hidden/metadata/chain-enabled checks). 67->66ms, delta ~1ms ~= noise; confidence <2x. Reverted (Hermes object property lookups are already too cheap for this to matter).
Exp7: memoized parsePriceToDecimal (module-level Map keyed by price double) + single-property-access getAmountFromBalance. 67->66ms (reps 64,74,66), delta ~= noise; confidence <2x. Reverted.

Exp8 (final): add unicode flag to INT_AMOUNT_RE/DEC_AMOUNT_RE for repo lint compliance (require-unicode-regexp). u-regexes cost ~4ms in Hermes (67->71) but keep the change lint-clean. Final: bigint exact-decimal accumulation + per-aggregation chain-enablement cache + exact decimal fiat product. 161->71ms (-56%), parity OK.

Final confirm + scaling sweep (parity OK at every scale): N=5 accounts cand 31ms vs orig 57ms (-45%); N=20 cand 71 vs orig 165 (-57%); N=60 cand 154-169 vs orig 440-463 (-64%). Advantage holds and grows with account count (more rows per aggregation). Production mirror applied to packages/assets-controller/src/selectors/balance.ts; vitest 40/40, tsc clean, oxlint clean.

change: parseAmount fallback: decompose bn.toFixed() at its decimal point instead of BigInt(bn.toFixed()) — the latter throws SyntaxError for any finite fractional fallback shape ('+5.5', '+.5', '1e-500', '1e-999999') where the original accumulated fine. Added deterministic amount-shape fuzz battery case (6 states x 6 accounts x 12 assets, LCG, shapes incl. +/- signs, whitespace, hex, underscores, junk, exponents 0-600 both sides of the 400 cap) + production test 'aggregates exotic amount shapes exactly as bignumber.js does' (41/41).
negative_test: fuzz battery crashes the pre-fix code (BigInt throw before SELF_CHECK prints) — battery demonstrably catches the bug class.
parity: SELF_CHECK=OK (fuzz battery included, 432+ exotic amount rows, ORIG vs CAND identical)

metric.note: battery now runs before timing; both impls shifted equally (orig 165->172, cand 71->75); ratio unchanged
